### 📂 Raw Impedance Data Extraction (EIS-1)

Cleans raw EIS text from electrochemical workstations into standard CSV.

#### 🛠️ Extraction Conventions
- **Column Order**: Automatically reordered to `Freq/Hz`, `Z'/ohm`, `Z''/ohm`.
- **Standardization**: Ensures correct sign for imaginary impedance (tools automatically handle absolute values from instruments).

> **💡 Tip**:
> - Generated label is `EIS1-CSV`, the unique source for subsequent Nyquist plots and $R_s$ extraction.
